TCP::rexmt_thresh
Description
TCP::rexmt_thresh
returns the retransmission threshold of a TCP
connection.
TCP::rexmt_thresh
TCP_REXMT_THRESH_VALUE sets the
retransmission threshold to specified value.
Syntax
TCP
::
rexmt_thresh
(
TCP_REXMT_THRESH_VALUE
)
?
TCP::rexmt_thresh
(TCP_REXMT_THRESH_VALUE)?
Return Value
TCP::rexmt_thresh
returns the retransmission threshold of a TCP
connection.
Examples
# Get/set the retransmission threshold of the TCP flow.
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"TCP set rtx thresh: [TCP::rexmt_thresh 100]"
log
local0.
"TCP get rtx thresh: [TCP::rexmt_thresh]"
}
